experiment: Seven full-scale multi-span continuous C- and Z-purlin roof assemblies (through-fastened and standing seam panels, lapped at interior supports) were loaded to failure under simulated uniform gravity load in a vacuum chamber, and the measured failure loads were compared with 1996 AISI predicted strengths computed under three negative-moment bracing assumptions.
title: Investigation of Inflection Points as Brace Points in Multi-Span Purlin Roof Systems

variables.definition: Test designation label identifying each of the seven full-scale roof assembly tests.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.24; Table 2.2 p.30; Tables 3.1-3.2 pp.37-38; Table 5.1 p.64; Tables 5.2-5.4 pp.65-66; Table S1
variables.name: Test designation
variables.note: Spelling varies between tables (e.g. 'I.P. Test n' vs 'I. P. Test n'; 'Test 2 Z-8S' in Table 5.3); s1_test_id is a curator-added join key.

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the purlins in the test, C or Z, as listed in the test matrix.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.24 (purlin_type); Table 2.2 p.30 (printed as '8 in. Z' etc.); Table S1 (section_type)
variables.name: Purlin cross-section shape
variables.note: In Table 2.2 the depth and shape are combined in one text cell.

variables.definition: Depth of the purlin section, given as nominal depth in the test matrix and as measured depth in the strength summary.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.24 (nominal, e.g. 8, 10); Table S1 (measured, e.g. 8.06, 10.06)
variables.name: Purlin depth
variables.note: Nominal (Table 2.1) and measured (Table S1) values differ slightly.

variables.definition: Measured base metal thickness of the failed purlin reported in the strength summary.
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: Differs from the tensile coupon thickness of Table 3.1 for some tests.

variables.definition: Roof panel/deck system attached to the purlin top flange (through-fastened or standing seam).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.24; Table 2.2 p.30; Table S1
variables.name: Panel type
variables.note: I. P. Test 3 Z-TF used a standing seam profile screwed directly to the flange, acting as through-fastened.

variables.definition: Text description of the number and length of the continuous spans in the test assembly.
variables.name: Span arrangement
variables.note: Text field; individual bay spans are given numerically in Table 2.2.

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test assembly.
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly.
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Span length of the instrumented test bay as printed in the test details table.
variables.name: Test bay span length

variables.definition: Span length of the middle bay for the three-span tests.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.30 (middle_bay_span_ft); blank for two-span I. P. tests
variables.name: Middle bay span length
variables.note: Empty for the two-span tests, which have no middle bay.

variables.definition: Span length of the end bay opposite the instrumented test bay.
variables.name: Opposite end bay span length

variables.definition: Total length of the overlapping purlins centered on an interior support.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.30 (total_lap_ft) and header note defining lap length
variables.name: Total lap length

variables.definition: Length that the purlin lap extends from the interior support into the instrumented test bay.
variables.name: Lap length into test bay
variables.note: One entry printed with a stray leading mark ('· 1.5 ft.').

variables.definition: Lateral bracing and anti-roll clip arrangement used in the test assembly.
variables.name: Bracing arrangement

variables.definition: Direction of the simulated uniform load applied in the vacuum chamber (gravity for all tests).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Measured thickness of the tensile coupon cut from the web of the failed purlin.
variables.name: Tensile coupon thickness
variables.note: Reported per coupon; averaged where several coupons were tested.

variables.definition: Measured width of the tensile coupon cut from the web of the failed purlin.
variables.name: Tensile coupon width

variables.definition: Yield stress of the purlin steel from tensile coupon tests, also listed (slightly different values) as the yield stress used in the AISI strength evaluation.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.37 (yield_stress_ksi); Table 5.1 p.64 (fy_ksi); Table S1 (yield_stress_ksi)
variables.name: Yield stress
variables.note: Table 5.1 values differ slightly from the Table 3.1 coupon values; I. P. Test 3 Z-TF yield stress was assumed equal to the other I. P. tests.

variables.definition: Ultimate tensile strength of the purlin steel measured in the coupon tests.
variables.name: Tensile strength
variables.note: Blank for I. P. Test 3 Z-TF (no coupon material).

variables.definition: Percent elongation at fracture of the tensile coupon.
variables.name: Coupon elongation
variables.note: Blank for I. P. Test 3 Z-TF (no coupon material).

variables.definition: Applied uniform line load on the purlin at failure, excluding deck and purlin self weight, obtained from the vacuum chamber pressure at failure.
variables.name: Applied failure load
variables.note: I. P. Test 2 Z-SS printed as 100.8 plf in Table 3.2 but 102.8 plf in Table S1/appendix sheets.

variables.definition: Experimental failure load used for comparison with the AISI predictions, nominally the applied load plus sheeting and purlin self weight.
variables.evidence: Tables 5.2-5.4 pp.65-66 (experimental_failure_load_plf) with header note on self weight
variables.name: Experimental failure load (comparison)
variables.note: Curator note states printed values actually match the applied load, not the total including self weight; preserved as printed.

variables.definition: Total uniform line load at failure including the weight of the deck (4.00 plf) and the purlin self weight, taken from the appendix test summary sheets.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (total_load_incl_self_weight_plf), appendix test summary sheets
variables.name: Total failure load incl. self weight

variables.definition: Vacuum chamber pressure at failure read from the manometer, in inches of water.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (failure_pressure_in_h2o), appendix test summary sheets
variables.name: Failure chamber pressure
variables.note: Converted to line load at 19.50 plf/in. (Virginia Tech) and 20.15 plf/in. (Ceco).

variables.definition: Governing moment in the test bay at the failure load, as printed on the appendix test summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (failure_moment_as_printed), appendix summary sheets pp.78,93,107,...
variables.name: Failure moment

variables.definition: Observed location and mode of failure in the test bay (positive region, negative region/local buckling outside the lap, etc.).
variables.evidence: Table 3.2 p.38 (failure_location, with * footnote); Table S1 (failure_mode)
variables.name: Failure location / mode
variables.note: Entries marked * denote local buckling just outside the lapped portion in the exterior span.

variables.definition: Effective section modulus of the failed purlin used in the AISI strength calculation.
variables.name: Effective section modulus

variables.definition: Effective yield moment of the failed purlin, computed as the product of Se and Fy.
variables.name: Effective yield moment

variables.definition: Unbraced length taken as the distance from the end of the lap to the theoretical inflection point in the test bay.
variables.name: Unbraced length to inflection point

variables.definition: Standing seam roof system strength reduction factor determined by the AISI Base Test Method, taken as 1.00 for through-fastened panels.
variables.evidence: Table 5.1 p.64 (r) and header note; Table S1 note (R = 0.435-0.453 for standing seam)
variables.name: Base test reduction factor

variables.definition: Moment gradient coefficient computed from AISI Eq. C3.1.2-11 for the negative moment region.
variables.name: Moment gradient coefficient Cb
variables.note: Used only in Table 5.3; Cb = 1.0 is assumed in Table 5.2.

variables.definition: Nominal moment strength of the positive moment region computed as R times Se times Fy.
variables.name: Positive moment strength

variables.definition: Nominal negative moment strength of the lapped region computed under the three bracing assumptions (Cb = 1.0, Cb from Eq. C3.1.2-11, or fully braced equal to SeFy).
variables.name: Negative moment strength
variables.note: Value depends on the bracing assumption of the parent table.

variables.definition: Nominal shear strength of the purlin web computed per AISI Section C3.2.
variables.name: Nominal shear strength

variables.definition: Negative moment strength reduced by the AISI combined shear and bending interaction equation.
variables.name: Shear-bending reduced moment

variables.definition: Governing predicted limit state (positive moment, negative moment, or combined shear and bending) for each test.
variables.name: Critical limit state
variables.note: Printed inconsistently as 'Shear - Bending' and 'Shear + Bending'.

variables.definition: Uniform line load predicted to cause failure in the critical limit state from the 1996 AISI Specifications.
variables.name: Predicted failure load
variables.note: Differs between tables according to the negative-moment bracing assumption.

variables.definition: Ratio of the experimental failure load to the load predicted by the combined shear-plus-bending limit state.
variables.name: Exp/pred ratio, shear-bending

variables.definition: Ratio of the experimental failure load to the predicted failure load for the governing critical limit state, reported for each bracing assumption.
variables.name: Exp/pred ratio, critical limit state
variables.note: Table 5.4 column heading printed as 'Experimental  Predicted' with the slash missing; Table 5.2 mean 1.056 (SD 0.0896), Table 5.3 mean 1.037 (SD 0.056), Table 5.4 mean 1.033 (SD 0.0504).

variables.definition: Spacing of the purlin lines and deck overhang defining the load tributary width, stated in a header note as 5 ft on center with 1 ft deck overhang each side (7 ft panel width).
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on loading setup
variables.name: Purlin spacing / tributary width
variables.note: Stated only in a note; the tributary width actually used for load conversion is not explicitly given.

variables.definition: Self weight of the roof deck, stated as 4.00 plf in the note describing how total load differs from applied load.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Deck self weight
variables.note: Single value stated in a note rather than a column.
